fields.summary_ko.0: Following announcement of CrowdStrike (CRWD) and Zscaler (ZS) merger negotiations, CrowdStrike shares fell more than 2%, while Zscaler surged more than 20% in pre-market trading.
fields.summary_ko.1: Amid rapid AI growth and rising cybersecurity importance, the combined entity would create a cybersecurity powerhouse, though regulatory and shareholder approvals are required.
